body.text: Scope for Photon, written down so we stop relitigating it: applications, clipboard history, notes, file search, and keybinds. No AI, no extensions, no account, no cloud sync, no telemetry. Swift 6 with AppKit for the panel and process behavior and SwiftUI for content. macOS 14 and later.
